# Scripts — gates, harnesses and probes

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_indexes.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every performance claim in this repo was produced by one of these, and the gates encode the
house rules: interleave A/B arms in one session, check the machine before trusting a number,
verify correctness before measuring speed.

Start with `machine_health.sh` (is the box healthy right now) and `bench_me.sh` (this Mac's
numbers against [PERFORMANCE.md](PERFORMANCE.md)). Run everything from the
repository root. Paths below are relative to `scripts/`.

## Gates: repository hygiene (no model needed)

Cheap, offline. `check_generated_docs.sh` and `check_no_local_paths.sh` fail on drift; `env_surface_guard.sh` is the ratchet on the number of `ARF_*` flags; `leak_scan.sh` runs before every push.

| script | what it does |
|---|---|
| `check_generated_docs.sh` | Fail if a generated doc is stale. EXAMPLES.md and SCRIPTS.md index things that exist on disk; |
| `check_no_local_paths.sh` | L264 — fail the build if a developer's home directory is committed in live code. |
| `env_surface_guard.sh` | THE RATCHET. |
| `leak_scan.sh` | Leak scan for the public repository: run before every push (the pre-push hook does) and in CI. |

| `mpp_e2e_parity.py` | Correctness first: the same 4 distinct prompts, sent CONCURRENTLY (so they batch), temperature 0, |
| `self_consistency.py` | THE CONTROL: the shipped path against itself (same binary, flags, 16 concurrent prompts, two daemon s… |
| `prefill_recall.py` | Did the engine READ the prompt? Facts planted at three depths of a long passage must come back. |
| `prefix_cache_hybrid.py` | The prefix cache on a HYBRID (recurrent) model must change how long an answer takes and |
| `ctx_cross_check.py` | Does the server survive a sequence CROSSING a context boundary while decoding? |

## Gates: make targets

`make gate` / `make gate-quick` run `nightly_gate.sh`; `make repro-conc` runs `repro_conc.sh`.

| script | what it does |
|---|---|
| `nightly_gate.sh` | THE ANTI-ROT HARNESS. |
| `repro_conc.sh` | REPRODUCE THE CANONICAL coder-30B CONCURRENCY NUMBERS — one command, footgun-proof. |

## Benchmarks

A number from any of these is quotable only with its arms interleaved in one session on a quiet box (see [PERFORMANCE.md](PERFORMANCE.md)). `bench_engines.py` produced the README's comparison table; `speed_bench.py` runs the SPEED-Bench coding workload on every engine installed.

| script | what it does |
|---|---|
| `bench_engines.py` | Five engines, ONE client, the same Qwen3.8-27B workloads — the README's comparison table. |
| `speed_bench.py` | SPEED-Bench coding prompts, the four measures other engines publish for Qwen3.8-27B — on THIS Mac. |
| `bench_me.sh` | "how fast is MY box?" |
| `honest_bench.sh` | Honest decode-throughput bench: warm-up (discarded) + median-of-3, reported per |
| `spec_ab.sh` | the interleaved greedy-vs-speculation A/B this repo has owed since L313. |
| `kernel_ab.sh` | the measurement ladder for a gated kernel experiment. |
| `ab_bench.py` | streamed decode-rate probe for kernel A/Bs. |
| `mpp_ladder.py` | Interleaved OFF/ON speed ladder (p50 step) for a switch, via `ab_bench.py`. MODEL/ARCH/EXTRA from MPP… |
| `real_conc_baseline.sh` | THE CONCURRENCY BASELINE, with REAL prompts and REAL text. |
| `soak_conc64.sh` | THE SUSTAINED number (vs the burst number every other bench reports). |
| `agent_bench/` | What a user of a coding agent feels: wall time from prompt to PASSING tests, per engine x agent x tas… |

## Machine and instrument checks

Run before believing any number (rule 8).

| script | what it does |
|---|---|
| `machine_health.sh` | ONE command: "is the GPU healthy or throttled RIGHT NOW?" |

## Reference implementations

Independent references the engine is checked against: written from the upstream model code, not from Arf's Rust.

| script | what it does |
|---|---|
| `ref/qwen3_omni/` | Qwen3-Omni audio encoder reference (`audio_encoder_ref.py`, `fetch_audio_tower.py`). |
| `ref/trellis2/` | TRELLIS.2 reference harness (`run_ref.py`, `compare.py`, `shim.py`, `fetch_weights.sh`). |
| `qwen_vision_ref.py` | Independent numpy reference for Arf's Qwen3.8 vision encoder (qwen3vl_merger mmproj). |
| `dump_hf_logits.py` | Reference logit dumper (HF transformers, f32), same schema as `arf dump-logits`. |
| `compare_logits.py` | Compare two JSONL logit dumps: top-1 agreement, top-5 overlap, KL, max \|Δlogit\|. |
| `hf_perplexity.py` | HF transformers reference perplexity for Correctness Ladder Layer 5. |
| `mlx_ppl.py` | Teacher-forced perplexity of an MLX model over a text, in ppl_windows' protocol. |
